description: This file defines the 'SearchModules' class within the 'SuiteCRM\Search' namespace. It handles retrieval and management of search modules for the SuiteCRM platform, including enabling/disabling modules for unified search, caching module definitions, and saving user preferences.

classes.name: SearchModules
classes.description: Provides static methods for managing search modules in SuiteCRM, including retrieving enabled/disabled modules, caching definitions, and updating display settings.

methods.name: getModulesList
methods.description: Returns a list of all modules available for search, merging enabled and disabled modules into a key-value map.

methods.name: getEnabledModules
methods.description: Returns an array of module names that are currently enabled for search.

methods.name: saveGlobalSearchSettings
methods.description: Saves the user's module search preferences, updating the display configuration file accordingly.

methods.name: getUnifiedSearchModulesDisplay
methods.description: Returns an array indicating which modules are visible for unified search, creating the display file if necessary.

methods.name: getUnifiedSearchModules
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about modules supporting unified search, building cache if missing.

methods.name: writeUnifiedSearchModulesDisplayFile
methods.description: Writes the list of visible modules for search display to a PHP configuration file.

methods.name: buildCache
methods.description: Generates and caches metadata about modules and their searchable fields for unified search.

methods.name: getAllModules
methods.description: Retrieves all modules with information about their enabled/disabled status for search.
